name: PaymentMethod
description: A list entity that represents the method of payment for received goods, where deletion is achieved by setting Active to false to make the record inactive.

update.note: Full update; request body must include all writable fields plus Id and SyncToken. Omitted writable fields are set to NULL.

fields.name: Id
fields.description: Unique identifier for this object. Required for update. Sort order is ASC by default.

fields.name: Name
fields.description: User recognizable name for the payment method.

fields.name: SyncToken
fields.description: Version number of the object. Required for update. Used to lock an object for use by one app at a time; incremented on each modification. Modifying with an older SyncToken fails.

fields.name: Active
fields.description: If true, this entity is currently enabled for use by QuickBooks.

fields.name: Type
fields.description: Defines the type of payment. Valid values include CREDIT_CARD or NON_CREDIT_CARD.

fields.name: MetaData
fields.description: Descriptive information about the object. The MetaData values are set by Data Services and are read only for all applications.

attributes.name: CreateTime
attributes.description: Time the entity was created in the source domain.

attributes.name: LastUpdatedTime
attributes.description: Time the entity was last updated in the source domain.
